title: SQL database
description: Example contract: a SQL database, both sides. properties: what its provider publishes, the size granted among it; x-okdp-secret: what its credentials Secret holds; x-okdp-claim: what a claim may request of the provider, a size.

size.description: The size granted, as requested or more; absent for a database no claim provisions.

x-okdp-claim.description: What a claim requests: the size of its database, 1Gi when it asks nothing.
